Hymn 4: Truth Eternal
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Alexander Schreiner
Lyricist/Text Author: Parley P. Pratt
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 4 titled "Truth Eternal" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Alexander Schreiner and the lyrics were written by Parley P. Pratt.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
